personalData.about: Fullstack Developer (Node.js, Vue 2.6) with 6 years in web development, including 3 with Vue 2.6, Vuex and Vue Router. Builds TypeScript services with Nest.js and Express and deploys them in Docker Swarm behind Traefik on AWS EC2. Removed hardcoded keys from Node.js services, integrated Microsoft Entra ID with OIDC, and used MongoDB Atlas, PostgreSQL, OpenSearch, Amazon S3, RabbitMQ and Redis. React experience spans 6 years and includes banking and cryptocurrency trading.

a5a44975-ee91-4012-980e-14d7a88a5e16.project: Energy and resource management web application for enterprise operators. Users plan programs and tasks, track implementation, and review costs and risks on dashboards served over HTTPS behind Traefik. Backend services run in Docker Swarm on AWS EC2 with MongoDB Atlas as the primary store, PostgreSQL on Amazon RDS for relational reporting, OpenSearch for log and metric search, and Amazon S3 for exported PDF and Excel files. Worked on the Node.js services and the React and Vue 2.6 web modules.
a5a44975-ee91-4012-980e-14d7a88a5e16.responsibilities: Built Nest.js and Express REST APIs for statistics, reporting and the task lifecycle with Swagger and Postman documentation; Removed hardcoded service keys from Node.js services and moved secrets to runtime configuration; Developed Vue 2.6 web modules with Vuex for shared state and Vue Router for navigation, built with Vue CLI and Webpack; Published the web UI and APIs through Traefik with HTTPS and TLS certificates from AWS Certificate Manager; Deployed Node.js services as Docker containers on AWS EC2 under Docker Swarm, with AWS Security Groups limiting ingress; Integrated Microsoft Entra ID sign-in alongside local authentication for CMS operator accounts; Stored operational data in MongoDB Atlas and report data in PostgreSQL on Amazon RDS, with OpenSearch for audit and metric fields; Stored generated PDF and Excel reports in Amazon S3 and processed async jobs through RabbitMQ with Redis caching; Developed React and Vue 2.6 dashboards with charts, a virtualized hours table and WebSocket approval notifications; Maintained GitHub Actions pipelines and covered critical API flows with Jest and Vue components with Vue Test Utils

1d7a0b02-33dd-4333-acce-b4a60a4cc392.project: Project and portfolio management web system that collects KPIs, tasks, assignments and events and renders them on charts. Services run on AWS EC2 in Docker Swarm behind Traefik with HTTPS and TLS. Data sits in MongoDB Atlas and PostgreSQL on Amazon RDS; OpenSearch supports search over exported reports. Worked on the Node.js services and React web client.
1d7a0b02-33dd-4333-acce-b4a60a4cc392.responsibilities: Developed Nest.js modules for KPI, task, assignment and event APIs consumed by the React web client; Exposed the application through Traefik with AWS Certificate Manager TLS and routed containers on a Docker Swarm cluster on AWS EC2; Restricted public ingress with AWS Security Groups and HTTPS-only proxy routes; Configured AWS IAM roles, an Amazon VPC, an Application Load Balancer and Route 53 for the application infrastructure on AWS; Monitored the services with Amazon CloudWatch; Persisted workload data in MongoDB Atlas and reporting tables in PostgreSQL on Amazon RDS, with OpenSearch for report metadata; Queued export jobs on RabbitMQ and cached KPI reads in Redis; Stored PDF, PPT and CSV exports in Amazon S3 with presigned URLs and bucket policies, and Zod validation on write payloads; Ran services in Docker on AWS with structured logs in OpenSearch and covered APIs with Jest

907ab985-055c-447e-8c9b-63431312a808.project: Banking and cryptocurrency exchange platform for a fintech company. Customers manage accounts, review balances and transactions, follow market data, and place and track cryptocurrency orders. Operations staff monitor trading activity and account status. The Node.js backend and React frontend run in Docker on AWS EC2 behind Traefik with HTTPS and TLS.
907ab985-055c-447e-8c9b-63431312a808.responsibilities: Designed PostgreSQL schemas on Amazon RDS and Nest.js REST APIs for customer accounts, balances, transactions and cryptocurrency orders; Implemented local authentication for operations staff and OIDC single sign-on through Azure AD (now Microsoft Entra ID) for internal users; Built the trading dashboard in React and delivered market-price and order-status updates over WebSocket; Used RabbitMQ for asynchronous order processing and Redis for session and market-data caching; Deployed containers with Docker and Jenkins pipelines on AWS EC2 with Traefik TLS termination; Covered account, transaction and order flows with Jest
